reviewer_role: independent static/statistical auditor, not supplementary model implementer
scope: Read-only source/API/information-boundary review; no market preparation, model fitting, checkpoint loading, or outcome measurement in this preflight.

static_checks.decomposition_window: Only price[t-63:t+1] passed to fixed N=3 EWT1D; last 17 component rows retained.
static_checks.feature_centering: Known origin price p[t] subtracted from raw level and first low band; no future target used.
static_checks.normalization: Unchanged V3 initial training-prefix target RMS for four price channels; unchanged original transforms for five auxiliary channels.
static_checks.auxiliary_alignment: Exactly the last 17 rows of the existing V3 normalized 64-by-6 window, columns 1:6.
static_checks.target_split_and_purge: prepare_swewt calls original prepare_replication; origins, masks, H1/5/20 labels, train scales and train horizon second moments are preserved.
static_checks.selection: Common neural_job uses each model actual forward for validation; seed 17 selects learning rate and epoch; fresh seeds 17/29/43 refit selected fixed epoch count.
static_checks.epoch_zero: Zero output head gives zero price changes, i.e. RW; epoch 0 remains eligible and explicitly reported.
static_checks.workers: Process-local preparation/model hooks are installed in main and worker initializer; frozen disk sources are not modified.
static_checks.freeze: Reference V3 core hashes checked; own runner/helper/EWT module identity recorded; nested original data manifest compared with reference.

required_interpretation: Added after at least partial V3 Beijing scores were inspected; separate descriptive supplement, outside the original V3 statistical comparison family.
A controlled multi-step adaptation of the published SWEWT-GRU structure, not author-code or numerical reproduction.
Fixed window64/N3, GRU32/direct H1/5/20 outputs, origin-centering/RMS, two learning rates/80 epochs/three seeds and full exogenous inputs differ from the original one-step tuned protocol.
The full arm receives 17 auxiliary tokens, shorter than the original V3 GRU/LSTM 64 auxiliary tokens; token-derived volume reference can extend earlier than these 17 records.
Within-window EWT coefficients may depend on later positions in the same observed window, all at or before issuance t; origin-level information availability is the appropriate boundary.
Subtracting p[t] is a valid known-origin centering operation; do not claim a general exact translation-equivariance theorem for adaptive EWT boundary selection.
ScienceDB author-cleaned transaction-mean target and historical non-vintage EIA/current reported-volume assumptions remain inherited from V3.

implementer_synthetic_receipt.review_scope: Receipt read and source hashes checked; synthetic checks executed by implementer, not independently repeated by this reviewer.

nonblocking_reproducibility_note: Exact equality of the nested V3 manifest also compares stored absolute source paths. To use a relocated data root, regenerate the reference V3 run at the same relocated paths rather than treating an archived manifest with old absolute paths as portable input.
